summary: Fourth review found residual shell-command indirection: substitutions, negation, and bare make can hide privileged targets from the parser.
validation: Prior extra-job and quoted-target findings were resolved
blockers: Require the PR validate run step to match an exact statically allowed command rather than attempting partial shell parsing.
next_action: Replace parser acceptance with exact allowed run-script matching and regression tests, then repeat review.

issues.title: Shell indirection hides privileged make execution
issues.details: echo $(make ci), ! make ci, and bare make are ignored; require the sole run step to be exactly make ci-pr (or explicit -f Makefile ci-pr).
